senses.gloss: Lambana is the reading in the kāṇva recension (v. 10, 1) of the Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad for āḍambara, ‘drum,’ in the Mādhyaṃdina recension (v. 12, 1).

Lāmakāyana, ‘descendant of Lamaka,’ is often mentioned as an authority in the Lāṭyāyana śrauta sūtra, the nidāna sūtra, and the Drāhyāyaṇa śrauta sūtra; also with the name Saṃvargajit in the vaṃśa brāhmaṇa.
